transfer_policy.scope: Harvard College study abroad; selected official policy summary, not Extension School
transfer_policy.rules: Faculty syllabus approval; C- minimum (departments may require more); up to 16 credits per semester abroad, 8 per summer, 32 total abroad excluding Harvard Summer School. Pass/fail generally ineligible unless no alternative.

transfer_policy.scope: MIT transfer credit
transfer_policy.rules: Department transfer-credit examiner approval; official transcript and approved request form; departmental minimum grades; HASS/CI require additional approval. Record grade S; excluded from GPA. No generic MIT-unit to US-hour factor.
